The danger severity message box uses the toned-down red-500 surface/border + red-300 🛑 icon (warning -> amber-500/amber-300 ⚠); the typed-confirmation TextInput resets on each reopen (useEffect[open]) and the confirm Button stays disabled until typed===requireTypedConfirmation (confirmDisabled = loading || !typedMatches), preserving the web gate. autoCapitalize='characters' + autoCorrect/spellCheck off are the mobile-keyboard equivalents of the web Input's autoComplete='off'/spellCheck=false for the uppercase RESET token. silenceKey/'Don't ask again' is omitted because ResetSection passes no silenceKey AND the web ConfirmDialog ignores silencing for danger / typed-confirmation prompts. Escape-to-cancel / backdrop dismissal map to Modal onRequestClose + a backdrop Pressable, both swallowed while loading (handleCancel = loading ? undefined : onCancel) to keep the dialog mounted during the in-flight mutation, matching the web handleModalClose.
